exact: protein arginine omega-N symmetric methylase activity
protein arginine omega-N symmetric methyltransferase activity
related: type II protein arginine methyltransferase activity

definition: Catalysis of the addition of a second methyl group to methylated peptidyl-arginine. Methylation is on the terminal nitrogen (omega nitrogen) residue that is not already methylated, resulting in symmetrical peptidyl-N(omega),N'(omega)-dimethyled arginine residues.
label: PRMT5 methylates TP53
